cd /app/dev && python3 - << 'PYEOF'
import json, subprocess, random, sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/app/dev')
import gen
stats = {'nonempty':0,'multisrc':0,'members_gt1':0,'multi_class':0,'amb':0,'viol':0,'width_gt1':0}
for seed in range(400):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    req = gen.gen_request(rng)
    p = subprocess.run(['python3','/app/submission/main.py'],input=json.dumps(req).encode(),capture_output=True)
    r = json.loads(p.stdout)
    if r.get('classes'): stats['nonempty']+=1
    if len(r.get('classes',[]))>1: stats['multi_class']+=1
    if any(c['members']>1 for c in r.get('classes',[])): stats['members_gt1']+=1
    if len(set(t['source'] for t in req['train']))>1: stats['multisrc']+=1
    for q in r.get('queries',[]):
        if q['status']=='ambiguous': stats['amb']+=1
        if q['status']=='violating': stats['viol']+=1
    for c in r.get('classes',[]):
        if len(c['representative']['or'])>1: stats['width_gt1']+=1
print(stats)
PYEOF
